notes.title: Try Hero Mania During Couch Co-Op Fest!
notes.content:
Hero Mania will be participating in Steam's Couch Co-Op Fest!

During the event, a demo of Hero Mania will be available to play for free!

Grab some friends and family and duke it out to see who can come out on top as the city's most popular hero!

notes.title: Demo Fixed - Now Playable!
notes.content:
Greetings, citizens and aspiring heroes alike!

Hero Mania's demo is now playable! A major configuration error on our part prevented the demo files from being downloaded. This issue has since been resolved!

We sincerely apologize for this error! Thank you to the community member who brought this to our attention! We apologize for taking so long to notice!

Due to the inability to experience the demo for the first few days of Steam Remote Play Together Fest 2024, we're going to extend the duration of the demo until February 22nd!

Thank you for your patience, please enjoy the rest of Steam Remote Play Together Fest 2024!

notes.title: Play Hero Mania During Steam Remote Play Together
notes.content:
A free, playable demo of Hero Mania will be live during Steam Remote Play Together Fest 2024!

Already gave the game a shot during Steam Next Fest February 2023? Play it again with all new characters, a new map, and a plethora of gameplay changes to freshen up your experience!

[h2]Two New Characters[/h2]
Bring order to the streets while bowling through your enemies as King Penguini, or powerbomb your opponents as your day job as Eva Extreme!

Two new characters make their way onto the roster of humored has-beens and elated egomaniacs! Try them out now!

[h2]A Brand-New Map[/h2]
Take the fight to the Construction Zone in an all new map, available in both Hero Mode and Back Alley Brawl!

notes.title: 🧊💬 Developer Q&A Cooldown
notes.content: Come hang out with the developers as we play the game and answer any questions!

notes.title: 💥👊 Fighting Crime (And Each Other!)
notes.content: Join us and hang out as we punch the living daylights out of each other! And also answer any questions you may have!

notes.title: Check Out Hero Mania During Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Stop by and check out [b]Hero Mania[/b] during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], from [b]February 6th[/b] through the [b]13th[/b]!

In a heroic celebration of the event, a [b]publicly playable demo[/b] will be available! So grab some friends, squeeze into a pair of sparkling spandex, and brawl your way to the top as the city's greatest hero!

The demo will feature [b]two game modes[/b], [b]two stages[/b], and [b]five playable heroes[/b]! 

Wait... [i]five[/i] playable heroes? But we've only announced four! Stay tuned for a new character reveal!

We'll also be doing a couple developer livestreams during the event! Dates and times for those streams will be announced at a later date.
 
Feel free to send us your thoughts about the game when you get your hands on it! We'd love to hear your feedback!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]Click here to learn more about Steam Next Fest![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:

Welcome to the devlog for Hero Mania! This periodic series will cover behind-the-scenes development, struggles, and neat tidbits as we show off the current state of the game, upcoming features, and more!

In this episode, we kick off with a quick introduction to the game, characters, and some of our development struggles!

Be sure to check back for more episodes, and follow us on social media for more development updates!
